key_developments: Democrats are favored to gain control of the House with approximately 50 competitive races, needing only 3 seats to flip the chamber.
Senate control remains highly competitive with six toss-up races and Democrats leading in nine of twelve competitive Senate races according to Nate Silver's forecast.
Trump's midterm convention in Dallas struggled to attract major candidates, with many GOP powerhouses opting out despite the president's central role in the campaign.
Data center development has emerged as a significant campaign issue across multiple battleground races, with Republican candidates distancing themselves from Trump's support for data centers.
Texas has emerged as a major battleground in the midterms, with Democrat James Talarico leading Republican Ken Paxton in the Senate race according to recent polling.
